decisions.reason: As the only 2018 pipe-related launch that clearly survived the initial review while similar bracket products disappeared quickly, it likely sits above the firm's aspiration level and fits its core metal-fabrication capabilities.

This is a more generic adjacent product in a competitive public-furnishing niche, so if its results are merely uncertain rather than clearly satisfactory, a German SME with limited slack would likely reallocate the resources.

The waste-bin-with-ashtray variant is more differentiated than a standard bin and can share production and sales resources with the rest of the line, making it worth retaining while performance remains acceptable but still uncertain.

A standalone outdoor ashtray is likely a narrower, lower-volume offer than the combined bin-and-ashtray product, so if it falls short of aspiration the firm would plausibly end it and focus on stronger or more related products.
